Opposition Slams Centre Over Police Action on Gandhi Jayanti

Opposition leaders and activists have criticized the central government over police action taken on Gandhi Jayanti. The criticism, which drew parallels to actions under British rule, was directed at the police's handling of protesters in Delhi.
